5396.nameId: The Tale of the Autumn Knight
5396.descriptionId: Now that your devotion has been completed, you can finally begin searching for the Dofus! Adviser Arky suggests you start your search in the library.

5398.nameId: Close Encounter of the Rat Kind
5398.descriptionId: Chris Mugler's business is struggling. He thinks his problems stem particularly from the Astrub sewers...

5400.descriptionId: The cities of Bonta and Brakmar are fighting to increase their influence in Astrub. Which city will you ultimately help? Or... betray?

5402.nameId: In the Footsteps of the Autumn Knight
5402.descriptionId: Arky has given you a list of people to help in Astrub. Perhaps this will earn you the same reputation as the Autumn Knight...

5404.descriptionId: Alfred Hitchfowl is about to make a major discovery about piwis. But without you, there's no guarantee he'll succeed...

5406.descriptionId: Chasing the Celestial Piwin won't be a walk in the park. It might even take you back to places you thought you'd never see again...

5408.descriptionId: You're finally in Incarnam! Your search for the Celestial Piwin is drawing to a close. Now you just have to carefully follow Alfred Hitchfowl's instructions.

5410.descriptionId: The farmers of Astrub are unable to work. Raymond Santho, their manager, is asking you to shed light on what's going on.

5412.descriptionId: Jeanette Berger is suggesting you develop a weed killer to get rid of aggressive plants. You'll need a few ingredients to do it.

5414.nameId: Take the Good With the Vandanabad
5414.descriptionId: You've finally got your hands on the troublemaker in the Astrub fields! But unfortunately, the rascal has now run off to the Field Dungeon. You must catch him, and be quick about it!

5416.descriptionId: The Flictid family's only son has disappeared. The young man appears to have an uneventful past. So, it's your job to find him.

5418.descriptionId: Your investigation has led you to the Astrub Rocky Inlet. You can feel you're getting close, but the few witnesses to Cain's last sightings aren't being very cooperative. Find a way to make them talk!

5420.descriptionId: Cain is said to be in the depths of the Sand Dungeon. Now you just have to make your way inside to find him!

5422.descriptionId: Harvey Caflip, the manager of the Astrub Tofuhouse, wants to show you around his empire! Unfortunately, things don't go according to plan, and you discover an adventure that you might have rather avoided.

5424.descriptionId: A big black tofu seems intent on destroying Harvey Caflip's business plans. Now you just have to find which one it is and make it stop.

5426.descriptionId: The tofus seem to be rebelling against the way they're being reared. Having a way of creating tofu nuggets without tofus could be beneficial to Caflip's business – that is, if you manage to find a recipe.

5428.nameId: The Beast Lurking in the Shadows
5428.descriptionId: A troublemaker called Bearman is said to have been spotted in Astrub. The reward for whoever flushes him out looks tempting.

5430.descriptionId: Your hunt for the Bearman in the forest is on track. Just a bit more effort, and you'll be able to afford a few hot meals at the inn!

5432.descriptionId: Your capture of the Bearman leads you to a secret passage beneath Astrub that the militia don't know about. You'll be doing the city a huge favour by helping Igor Ant unravel this mystery.

5434.descriptionId: The next step in your journey to Tainela is marked by an invitation from the Fahmer family to stay at theirs for a while.

5436.descriptionId: Orphelia Fahmer has succeeded, and many visitors are expected in Tainela to meet Rascal. But she is asking you for one last favour to save the village's image.

5438.descriptionId: Although you've helped a great many Astrubian citizens, Ratathrosk still hasn't bothered to show his face. Your only hope now is to find the Autumn Knight's tomb.

5440.descriptionId: You've finally met Ratathrosk, the dragon protector of Astrub! But there's so much more for you to discover. Adviser Arky will be able to guide you to new adventures.

5446.descriptionId: The quest for the artefact has begun. Confront the monsters of the Field Dungeon.

5448.descriptionId: Don't stop showing your determination: the Tofu House is waiting for you...

5450.descriptionId: Don't stop showing your determination: enter the Gobball Dungeon!

5452.descriptionId: Don't stop showing your determination: take your carcass for a walk in the Skeleton Dungeon!

5454.descriptionId: The Key Master sends you to visit one of his friends.

5458.descriptionId: Once you've finished your achievements, go back and see Arky to show her that you've mastered crafting.

5462.descriptionId: Once you've finished the Marketplace demonstration, go back and see Arky to complete your introduction to trade.

5464.descriptionId: Talk to Arky to find out what's next.

5466.descriptionId: Bossawa needs your help to get some sleep, by defeating the fearsome monsters in Pandala! He wants you to start with Nagate.

5468.descriptionId: Bossawa needs your help to get some sleep, by defeating the fearsome monsters in Pandala! He wants you to settle the score with Tanukouï San.

5470.descriptionId: Bossawa needs your help to get some sleep, by defeating the fearsome monsters in Pandala! He wants you to settle the score with Founoroshi.

5472.descriptionId: Bossawa needs your help to get some sleep, by defeating the fearsome monsters in Pandala! He wants you to settle the score with the duo Shihan and Hanshi.

5474.descriptionId: Bossawa needs your help to get some sleep, by defeating the fearsome monsters in Pandala! He wants you to settle the score with Damadrya.

5476.descriptionId: Bossawa needs your help to get some sleep, by defeating the fearsome monsters in Pandala! He wants you to settle the score with Katamashii.

5489.descriptionId: The Laughing Trool has asked you to bring him 10 Multiman Balloons scattered around the World of Twelve, and has promised a fabulous reward if you do.

5491.descriptionId: Paul Raskell has asked you to investigate the curse affecting the polters in the Enchanted Edge village.

5492.descriptionId: Your adventures in Pandala are far from over. Return to the master calligrapher to find out where your journey will take you next.

5493.descriptionId: You are an unwilling pawn in the dark witches' game. To convince them without making them suspicious, Paul Raskell has offered to create a polter doll for you to use as a sacrifice.

5494.descriptionId: The recently remade Trool Fair features a number of new attractions. Why not have a look around?

5495.descriptionId: Alongside Meriana, your objective is now to dissolve the dark witches' sect and reason with Hell Mina. Not a simple task...

5496.descriptionId: After your feat against Bunky, Captain Amakna has asked you to take care of a few missions for him at the Trool Fair.

5497.descriptionId: Mishell has asked for your help in reuniting lost pairs of animals in the World of Twelve. She won't be able to bear it if they don't find their soul mates!

5498.descriptionId: Captain Amakna has one last mission for you: find the Multimen! They're incommunicado, so you'll need to use their respective totems to locate them.

5499.descriptionId: Save an endangered myxomassive in the Dark Jungle.

5501.descriptionId: Save an endangered falcombustion in the Orado Bayou.

5503.descriptionId: Save an endangered wilderlily in the Enchanted Lakes.

5505.descriptionId: Save an endangered mysticorn in the Icefields.

5507.descriptionId: Save an endangered yellobolder in the Minerock Plains.

5509.descriptionId: Clematys is investigating the secrets of the Labyrinth. She needs your help.

5511.descriptionId: Now you've uncovered Ereziah Melkewel's identity, it's time to explore the Labyrinth in greater depth...

5513.descriptionId: The Minotoror has told you the secret of a really clever adventurer called Nosdivan who used a magic thread to find his way through the Minotoror's labyrinth... It's the start of an interesting way to jump into the Labyrinth!

5515.descriptionId: Adrian's Thread has been crafted and placed by Jerael and Clematys, so all you need to do is follow it to explore the depths...

5517.descriptionId: In the Labyrinth, time passes more quickly... which is extremely dangerous for your body! You can think of just one person to counteract the effects of time: Count Harebourg...

5519.nameId: Musha the Oni is up to no good!
5519.descriptionId: Musha the Oni has gone back to his old home... Hunt him down in the Evil Forest before he hurts someone!

5527.descriptionId: Defeat the Gorgoyle in the Dragon Pig's Den

5535.descriptionId: After a well-deserved rest, it's time for you and Clematys to return to the Labyrinth. Thanks to the pocket watch that Count Harebourg lovingly crafted for you, you're no longer worried about the effects of time on your body when you descend into the depths. Ereziah Melkewel is waiting for you...

5537.descriptionId: Ereziah is free. The seal is broken... What will happen now?

5539.descriptionId: The Ebony Dofus rejected you! Your plan to claim it seems to have failed... Things look to be getting worse.

5541.descriptionId: Thanks to Snag, you managed to find a way to reach Ereziah! Now that the way is clear, it's time to return to the surface.

5542.descriptionId: You have enough information to go and look for the amphibrute. Head to the Astrub Rocky Inlet and hunt for a few snappers so the amphibrute will come out of hiding.

5543.descriptionId: Shadow has returned to the depths of the Labyrinth after you defeated him. Grougalorasalar has promised to return and find you when his strength has fully returned. Clematys has the Ebony Dofus... but where has she gone? What happened to her?

5544.descriptionId: Oshimo has conducted research on endangered animals in the vicinity of Astrub. Any help in finding and helping to preserve them would be welcome.

5546.descriptionId: You have enough information to go and look for the wallaburn. Head to Tofu Corner and look for signs.

5548.descriptionId: You have enough information to go and look for the betapir. The trees in Astrub Forest should have a few seeds that it loves.

5550.descriptionId: You have enough information to go and look for the siroccorn. Ask the Fahmer family for help in luring it with food.

5552.descriptionId: There are rumours that Oshimo has information about endangered animals. It would be wise to go and see him to find out more!
